patterns.note: Dramatic full-bleed hero sections with strong typographic focus, transitioning to a mix of full-width and centered content blocks for subsequent sections.
High contrast between oversized, elegant black serif display font for main headings and clean, legible sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
Dominant use of a vibrant orange as a primary accent and background, contrasted sharply with black and white for a bold, modern aesthetic.

A distinct hero transition on scroll, where an initial bold typographic screen with an orange background slides up to reveal a dark background with a video/image hero, accompanied by new text and a transformed sticky navigation.
Sections are clearly delineated by full-width background colors (orange, black, white) or full-bleed imagery, creating strong visual breaks and hierarchy.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered reveal, likely using GSAP, where an initial full-screen typographic hero with a solid background slides away to expose a video or image hero beneath it. Simultaneously, the main headline text fades out while a new, aspirational headline fades in over the revealed visual content.

A sticky header transformation occurs on scroll, where the top-right navigation area dynamically changes from a simple 'DOWNLOAD APP' link to a full social media and policy menu, while the logo and 'BOOK NOW' button remain sticky and adapt their styling.

Typography is used for dramatic effect by pairing a very large, elegant serif display font for impactful headlines with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other textual content, creating a clear visual hierarchy and sophisticated feel.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, elegant serif headings (up to ~5x body) for dramatic impact, paired with clean, legible sans-serif for body and UI elements.
design_tokens.radius: Mostly sharp, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like app screenshots and some buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero area, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its dramatic, oversized serif typography paired with a bold, high-contrast color palette (vibrant orange, black, white). The scroll-triggered hero transition, which completely transforms the initial view from a typographic statement to a visual hero, is particularly striking and memorable.
